trigger: A validator, First Mate worker, tmux session, or experimental runtime gate fails.
steps: Classify failure as harness, First Mate, worker/project, session backend, or external dependency.
Do not switch to Herdr merely because tmux or a worker failed; runtime promotion has separate gates.
Repair only the owning lane and rerun the focused gate.
Escalate after repeated no-progress or when the defect lies in forbidden/governance/product scope.
failure_handling: Stop at the first real authority, capability, or ownership boundary and name it.
proof_ceiling: workflow-state evidence only unless the owning runtime/validator produces stronger proof
